title: The Garden of Gethsemane Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Garden of Gethsemane Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Gethsemane Bible crossword: the sleeping disciples, “let this cup pass”, the kiss, and the ear of Malchus. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: He takes three of them further in, tells them his soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death, and goes a little forward to pray the same prayer three times. Each time he comes back they are asleep. The Garden of Gethsemane covers Mark 14 with the other accounts alongside.
The arrest is in the grid too — the lanterns and torches, the kiss, the drawn sword and the servant's ear. The closing verse is the prayer itself, in the words Mark keeps in Aramaic.

clues.text: “___, Father, all things are possible unto thee”

verseText: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
